title: [Color Picker] Long color format names are cut off, including default DECIMAL
author: object-Object

judgment.rationale: The issue provides a clear screenshot and deterministic UI reproduction for long Color Picker format labels being clipped. Public labels already mark the work as small, help wanted, and in progress.
evidence: The default DECIMAL label is visibly clipped to a misleading final character.
The report gives direct steps in Color Picker editor.
Labels include Status-In progress, Help Wanted, Cost-Small, and Product-Color Picker.
judgment.recommended_action: Continue the existing in-progress Color Picker UI work and verify long built-in and custom format names across scaling and localization.

fix_assessment.rationale: A UI fix is justified, but the lightweight pass did not identify a linked implementation or enough current layout evidence to prescribe a specific sizing strategy.

proposed_fixes.title: Make Color Picker format labels resilient to long names
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The Color Picker editor allocates insufficient label width and clips text without a clear overflow treatment, causing even the built-in DECIMAL name to render misleadingly.
plan: Update the format-name layout to provide an explicit width or ellipsis policy that fits built-in names.
Apply the same policy to custom and localized format labels without forcing the editor off screen.
Add UI coverage for long labels at common display scaling values.
verification: Open the editor with DECIMAL and several longer custom/localized names and confirm labels are readable or clearly ellipsized.

confidence.rationale: The screenshot directly demonstrates a deterministic layout constraint, and the correction is isolated to label sizing/overflow behavior.

issue_context.summary: Color Picker's format-name column clips long labels, including the built-in DECIMAL label.
known_information: The defect is directly visible in the supplied screenshot.
Several viable layout strategies are listed by the reporter.
The issue is already marked in progress.
inferences: Localization and display scaling may produce wider labels than the original example.
issue_context.analysis: The issue should remain on the existing implementation track rather than return to author-information triage.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the current public issue body, labels, assignees, and up to the latest 20 public comments returned by GitHub.
Kept the existing dashboard read-only; no dashboard files were modified or published.

actions.label: Approve make color picker format labels resilient to long names
actions.note: Approve/start the fork-side design workflow from this public-evidence fix plan. No upstream write occurs from this action.
